page.layout: One printed page with a main text column of dictionary entries; a narrow column of marginal notes runs down the right edge, partly cut off by the scan. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left.

main_text.p: Διάκονος, ὁ, ἡ minister a. ex διὰ quod in sompositione significationem intendit, & κρέω festino q. d. præsestinans, expeditus. comp. Διακονέστερος expeditior. Tribuitur magistratui, Rom.13.4. iis qui præerant ærario Ecclesiastico & eleemosynas in pauperes erogabant, unde dicebantur διακονεῖν τραπέζας, Act.6.2. item iis qui docebant Evangelium, 1.Cor.3.5. pascentes scil. animam.
Διακόσιοι, αι, α ducenti æ a, Marc.6.37.
Διακούομαι plenè audio q.d. peraudio. F.1.med. Διηκούσαμην pergam audire, Act.23.25. a.1. med. διηκουσάμην ω ἀῤῥ.

Διακρίνω discerno. feligo, alii præfero. imperf. Διέκρινον dijudicabam. F Διακρινῶ. P. Διακρίνομαι a.1. Διέκρινα discrevi. præf.med. Διακρίνομαι judicio in diversas quasi partes propendeo, modo scil. in affirmationem, modo in negationem. dubito, ambigo item diversum sentio, certo. item habeo delectum, Jud.v.22. prat.imperf. Διεκρινόμην ω ἐδ, Act. 11.2. altercabar. P.paff. Διακέκριμαι. a.1.paff. Διεκρίθην dubitavi.
Διάκρισις, εως, ἡ discretio, dijudicatio, 1.Cor.12. v 10. certamen, Rom.14.1.
Διακωλύω obnixè prohibeo. imperf. Διεκώλυον, Matth 3,14. Fut. κωλύσω. P. Διακεκώλυμαι. aor.1. Διεκώλυσα.
Διαλαλέω ῶ divulgo. imperf. Διελάλουν ἐν. Fut. λαλήσω. P. Διαλελάλημαι. præf.paff. Διαλαλέομαι ἡμας.

page.notes: The right margin notes are cut off at the scan edge and are largely illegible; their fragments include Greek and Latin references (e.g. "Act.", "Matth.", "Marc.", "Rom.", "Ioan."). They are not transcribed beyond these fragments. Greek forms in the entries are copied as far as legible; accents and breathings are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. The page number "H4" is read as printed; the running head "A I" is read as printed.
